cards.ex: My roommate's pretty easy-going, so we never argue.
cards.exUz: Xonadoshim juda yuvosh, shuning uchun biz hech qachon tortishmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan kelishadigan, xarakteri yumshoq odam.

cards.ex: My grandpa is pretty set in his ways; he won't use a smartphone.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom o'z odatlarida qotib qolgan; u smartfon ishlatmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z odatlaridan voz kechmaydigan, o'zgarmaydigan.

cards.ex: She's such a people person; everyone loves working with her.
cards.exUz: U juda ko'pchilik bilan til topisha oladi; hamma u bilan ishlashni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan oson munosabat o'rnata oladigan odam.

cards.ex: Stop being so silly and act your age!
cards.exUz: Bunday ahmoq bo'lishni bas qil va yoshingga mos bo'l!
cards.uzDef: O'zingni yoshingga mos tutish kerak.

cards.ex: If you want to pass the exam, you need to get your act together.
cards.exUz: Agar imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni qo'lga olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z ishlaringni tartibga solish, mas'uliyatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: Despite being famous, she's really down to earth.
cards.exUz: Mashhur bo'lishiga qaramay, u juda oddiy.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, kamtarin va realistik bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: He tends to keep to himself and doesn't socialize much.
cards.exUz: U o'ziga qarab yuradi va ko'p muloqot qilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan kam muloqot qilish, yolg'izlikni afzal ko'rish.

cards.ex: Nobody likes a know-it-all who always corrects people.
cards.exUz: Hech kim hamma narsani bilaman deydigan, doimo odamlarni tuzatadigan odamni yoqtirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani bilishini da'vo qiladigan, o'zini aqlli ko'rsatadigan odam.

cards.ex: She's such a control freak; she has to plan everything.
cards.exUz: U juda nazorat o'rnataveradi; u hamma narsani rejalashtirishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani nazorat qilishni xohlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: My mom is such a worrywart; she's always concerned about something.
cards.exUz: Onam juda xavotir oladigan; u doimo nimadandir xavotirda.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda xavotir oladigan odam.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile to help her friends.
cards.exUz: U doimo do'stlariga yordam berish uchun ko'proq harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Keragidan ko'proq harakat qilmoq, qo'shimcha kuch sarflamoq.

cards.ex: I just asked a question, and he bit my head off!
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki savol berdim, va u menga jahl bilan gapirdi!
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga qattiq va jahl bilan gapirmoq.

cards.ex: He has a short fuse, so be careful what you say to him.
cards.exUz: Uning tez jahli chiqadi, shuning uchun unga nima deyishingizga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan jahli chiqadigan odam.

cards.ex: His constant complaining really gets on my nerves.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyati menga juda asabga tegadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir asabini buzmoq, g'ashini keltirmoq.

cards.ex: He seems like a cold fish, but he's actually very kind.
cards.exUz: U sovuq odamga o'xshaydi, lekin aslida juda mehribon.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ulari kam bo'lgan, mehribon bo'lmagan odam.

cards.ex: She's such a social butterfly; she knows everyone at the party.
cards.exUz: U juda do'stona; u ziyofatda hamma bilan tanish.
cards.uzDef: Hamma bilan oson muloqot qiladigan, ko'p do'stlari bor odam.

cards.ex: He's become a real couch potato since he retired.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri haqiqiy dangasaga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Televizor oldida ko'p vaqt o'tkazadigan, harakatsiz odam.

cards.ex: I bent over backwards to help her, and she didn't even say thank you.
cards.exUz: Men unga yordam berish uchun jondan o'tdim, va u hatto rahmat ham aytmadi.
cards.uzDef: Kim uchundir juda ko'p harakat qilmoq, haddan tashqari urinmoq.

cards.ex: He flew off the handle when I told him I crashed his car.
cards.exUz: Men unga mashinasini urib yuborganimni aytganimda, u jahl otiga mindi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga juda jahli chiqib ketmoq.

cards.ex: Just play it cool, and don't let them see you're nervous.
cards.exUz: O'zingni bosib ol va ularga asabiylashganingni ko'rsatma.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatga xotirjam munosabatda bo'lish, o'zingni nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: He finally had to face the music for his bad behavior.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat yomon xulqi uchun javobgarlikka tortildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ishlaring uchun oqibatlarini qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: As a rule of thumb, you should arrive 15 minutes early.
cards.exUz: Taxminiy qoida sifatida, siz 15 daqiqa oldin kelishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Amalda qo'llaniladigan, lekin har doim ham to'g'ri bo'lmagan qoida.

cards.ex: I think we should let sleeping dogs lie and not bring up the past.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, biz eski dardni qo'zg'amasligimiz va o'tmishni eslatmasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoli vaziyatni qayta ochmaslik, eski muammolarni eslatmaslik.

cards.ex: Let's cut to the chase; how much money do you need?
cards.exUz: Asosiy mavzuga o'taylik; sizga qancha pul kerak?
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz tafsilotlarsiz, asosiy mavzuga tezda o'tish.

cards.ex: To solve this problem, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va ijodiy yechimlar topish, standart fikrlashdan chetga chiqish.

cards.ex: He always calls a spade a spade, even if it's uncomfortable.
cards.exUz: U har doim ochiq gapiradi, hatto noqulay bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri va ochiq gapirmoq, haqiqatni yashirmaslik.

cards.ex: We need to make sure we're all on the same page before we start.
cards.exUz: Ishni boshlashdan oldin, hammamiz bir fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir-birini tushunish.

cards.ex: Don't be such a nit-picker; focus on the big picture.
cards.exUz: Bunday maydachilik qiladigan bo'lma; katta rasmga e'tibor qarat.
cards.uzDef: Har doim mayda xatolarni qidiradigan odam.

cards.ex: She has a heart of gold and always helps those in need.
cards.exUz: Uning oltin yuragi bor va doimo yordamga muhtojlarga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon va saxiy odam.

cards.ex: I was a bundle of nerves before my job interview.
cards.exUz: Ishga suhbatga kirishdan oldin juda asabiy edim.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiylashgan, xavotirda bo'lgan odam.
